hide_when_off.label: Hide when inactive
hide_when_off.description: Hide the modifier bar widget when no modifier key is latched.

workspace_glyphs.label: Workspace name-to-glyph mappings
workspace_glyphs.description: Optional comma-separated mappings by workspace name or index, for example Home=home, 1=briefcase. Unmapped workspaces show the first letter of their name.

show_progress_when_inactive.label: Show progress when inactive
show_progress_when_inactive.description: Keep progress strips visible when no gesture is in progress. Hiding them animates the strip out.

shrink_inactive_workspace_pills.label: Shrink inactive workspace pills (Y-axis only)
shrink_inactive_workspace_pills.description: Make inactive workspace pills square and show only their icon or index. This setting only affects the Y-axis map.

workspace_pill_width.label: Workspace pill width (Y-axis)
workspace_pill_width.description: Fixed width in pixels for workspace pills in the Y-axis map.

workspace_pill_height.label: Workspace pill height (Y-axis)
workspace_pill_height.description: Fixed height in pixels for workspace pills in the Y-axis map.

animate_workspace_pill_resizing.label: Animate workspace pill resizing
animate_workspace_pill_resizing.description: Animate workspace pills between square and full size in the Y-axis map.

workspace_pill_resize_duration.label: Workspace pill resize duration
workspace_pill_resize_duration.description: Duration in milliseconds for workspace pill resize animation.

open_launcher_on_empty_workspace.label: Open Launcher on empty workspace
open_launcher_on_empty_workspace.description: In X-axis mode, show a plus button when the focused workspace is empty; click it to open the Noctalia launcher.

launcher_opening_command.label: Launcher opening command
launcher_opening_command.description: Shell command used to open the launcher from the empty-workspace button or on focus. Defaults to the Noctalia launcher IPC command.

open_launcher_on_focus.label: Open Launcher on focus
open_launcher_on_focus.description: Automatically run the opening command when the focused workspace becomes empty.

close_launcher_leaving_empty_workspace.label: Close launcher leaving empty workspace
close_launcher_leaving_empty_workspace.description: Close the Noctalia launcher when focus leaves an empty workspace.

open_launcher_at_workspace_edge.label: Open Launcher at workspace edge
open_launcher_at_workspace_edge.description: Open the launcher when a gesture reaches the configured edge of the focused workspace.

launcher_glyph.label: Launcher glyph
launcher_glyph.description: Noctalia glyph shown at the configured end of the X-axis progress bar when gesturing toward a workspace edge.

dominant_axis_progress.label: Show progress only for the dominant axis
dominant_axis_progress.description: Suppress this map's progress when movement is more strongly aligned with the other axis. Enable on both maps to avoid simultaneous X and Y progress; X wins ties.

dynamic_progress_opacity.label: Dynamic progress opacity
dynamic_progress_opacity.description: Fade the progress bar from transparent to fully opaque as gesture progress increases.

hide_empty_workspaces.label: Hide empty workspaces
hide_empty_workspaces.description: Hide workspaces that have no windows in the Y-axis workspace map.

workspace_badge_radius.label: Workspace badge corner radius
workspace_badge_radius.description: Corner radius in pixels for the workspace name or glyph badge.

widget_width.label: X-axis map layout size
widget_width.description: X-axis columns map size in pixels along its layout direction.

target_min_width_percent.label: X-axis target pill minimum size
target_min_width_percent.description: Minimum column pill width in horizontal layout or height in vertical layout, as a percentage of the configured X-axis map layout size.

pill_radius.label: Target pill corner radius
pill_radius.description: Corner radius in pixels for each target pill.

icon_size_percent.label: Icon size
icon_size_percent.description: Icon or workspace index size as a percentage of the target pill's smaller dimension.

horizontal_pill_padding.label: Horizontal target pill padding
horizontal_pill_padding.description: Inner padding in pixels at the start and end of each target pill.

vertical_pill_padding.label: Vertical target pill padding
vertical_pill_padding.description: Inner padding in pixels at the top and bottom of each target pill.

progress_thickness_percent.label: Progress thickness
progress_thickness_percent.description: Progress strip thickness as a percentage of the icon or index size.

icon_progress_gap.label: Icon-progress gap
icon_progress_gap.description: Gap in pixels between the icon or index and the progress strip.
